description: Kait's Grooming in Hornell offers full-service grooming including complete haircuts, baths, nail care, and ear cleaning starting at $70, plus specialized services for cats, rabbits, and guinea pigs. The salon provides additional options like bath and tidy maintenance appointments, deshed treatments for heavy shedding breeds, and one-on-one appointments designed for anxious or difficult pets. Located at 7731 Industrial Park Rd, the groomer emphasizes fear-free handling and maintains a calm environment while working closely with local veterinarians. A $25 deposit is required for new clients to secure appointments.
